subject: change_brief
summary: ChangeBrief change-brief.json passes adversarial critique: non-empty concrete in_scope and out_of_scope with no contradictions, success_criteria are observable (ops return correct results, named domain errors for div/rem by zero, memory start/clear/recall/add/subtract, checkable HTTP and module surfaces), open_questions is empty with high confidence and no required human_gate. Scope is sliceable for decompose; polish gaps (negative remainder sign, exact error type name) do not remove checkability at brief density.

findings.detail: Remainder (and possibly division) sign/rounding for negative operands is not pinned. Decompose and contracts can choose Examples/oracles; not a missing in/out or slogan-only success criterion.

Named domain error is required and distinguishable from opaque language errors, but the exact error type/name is left to later apply-dbc/implement. Acceptable for a ChangeBrief; only becomes checkability-critical once contracts omit a failure path entirely.
